metadata.evidence: * [Core](https://w3id.org/mdo/core/1.0): This module consists of the top-level concepts and relationships of the materials design ontology, which are also reused in other modules.
metadata.evidence_location: 11; ### What does Materials Design Ontology consist of?
metadata.reason: Provides the persistent URL endpoint for the Core module of MDO.

metadata.evidence: * [Structure](https://w3id.org/mdo/structure/1.0): The structure module is intended to represent the structural information of materials. Such structural information is also the basis of materials calculations.
metadata.evidence_location: 13; ### What does Materials Design Ontology consist of?
metadata.reason: Provides the persistent URL endpoint for the Structure module of MDO.

metadata.evidence: * [Calculation](https://w3id.org/mdo/calculation/1.0): This module is intended to represent the classification of different computational methods.
metadata.evidence_location: 15; ### What does Materials Design Ontology consist of?
metadata.reason: Provides the persistent URL endpoint for the Calculation module of MDO.

metadata.evidence: * [Provenance](https://w3id.org/mdo/provenance/1.0): This module is intended to represent the provenance information of materials data and calculation.
metadata.evidence_location: 17; ### What does Materials Design Ontology consist of?
metadata.reason: Provides the persistent URL endpoint for the Provenance module of MDO.
